announcements.headline: Thule to hold investor update event
announcements.insight: Thule Group is holding an investor update event following its Q3 interim report. Shareholders should watch for strategic commentary or guidance updates.

announcements.headline: Thule interim report, third quarter 2026, July - September
announcements.insight: Thule Group AB published its interim report for the third quarter of 2026. This follows recent governance updates regarding the nomination committee and shareholder meeting requests.

announcements.headline: Withdrawal of the request for an extraordinary shareholders' meeting – Per-Arne Blomquist appointed new Chairman of the Board at Thule
announcements.insight: Per-Arne Blomquist is appointed Chairman following the October request for an extraordinary general meeting. This leadership change follows the earlier nomination committee appointment.

announcements.headline: Thule Group has received a request for an Extraordinary General Meeting for election of the Board of Directors, following which the Chairman has resigned
announcements.insight: The Chairman has resigned following a shareholder request for an Extraordinary General Meeting to elect new Board members. This follows the earlier appointment of a nomination committee ahead of the 2027 Annual General Meeting.

announcements.headline: Nomination committee appointed ahead of 2027 Annual General Meeting of Thule Group (publ)
announcements.insight: Thule Group AB has appointed a nomination committee ahead of its 2027 Annual General Meeting. This board-level governance step may influence future leadership decisions.
